ALERT.trigger_condition: Prediction score PSI in [0.10, 0.25) or latency p95 in (15ms, 25ms]
ALERT.action: Notify on-call ML engineer. Monitor incoming traffic for abnormal merchant batching.

INVESTIGATE.trigger_condition: Calibrated score PSI >= 0.25 for > 15 minutes or novel device rate > 25%
INVESTIGATE.action: Extract recent 500 transactions, inspect IP subnet distribution, check merchant fraud reporting lag.

ROLLBACK.trigger_condition: Live API 5xx rate > 0.5%, p95 latency > 50ms, or customer insult FPR > 12%
ROLLBACK.action: Execute hot-swap rollback to v7.0-bmr-36f via export PRODUCTION_MODEL_PATH.

RETRAIN.trigger_condition: Confirmed statistical drift persisting > 30 days with newly acquired verified ground-truth chargebacks.
RETRAIN.action: Trigger chronological walk-forward training pipeline on expanded historical window.

model_retirement_criteria.v4.0_retirement: Retire when storage threshold exceeded or after 180 days in archive.
model_retirement_criteria.v8.0_review_cadence: Scheduled quarterly governance review or on-demand upon critical drift alert.
